actions.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Federal Lands.
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects land management agencies (Forest Service and Bureau of Land Management) and local populations, sportsmen, and visitors in Montana utilizing the affected public lands.
dimensions.evidence: The approximately 81,000 acres of land comprising the Middle Fork Judith Wilderness Study Area... shall no longer be subject to section 3(a) of the Montana Wilderness Study Act of 1977

dimensions.assessment: Changes the legal management framework for over 100,000 acres of public land, allowing wildlife habitat and wildfire mitigation projects and enhanced backcountry access.
dimensions.evidence: land managers would be able to better conserve and manage the areas in accordance with applicable land and resource management plans... while providing for enhanced sportsmen opportunities

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state or imply significant federal spending, revenue, or broader economic effects.
Releases specific named wilderness study areas in Montana from prior statutory restrictions and mandates management under existing resource plans.
dimensions.evidence: The approximately 11,380 acres of land comprising the Hoodoo Mountain Wilderness Study Area and the approximately 11,580 acres of land comprising the Wales Creek Wilderness Study Area... shall no longer be subject to section 603(c) of the Federal Land Policy and Management Act of 1976

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory release of wilderness study area status for the specified lands in Montana.

missing_information: Specific budget allocations or costs associated with changing management plans for the released acreage.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill releases approximately 103,960 total acres of public land across specific wilderness study areas in Montana from wilderness study area designations and directs their management under standard land and resource management plans.

latest_action.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
